entities.name: Dong Cunrui
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dong Cunrui was a Chinese Communist soldier in the People's Liberation Army during the Chinese Civil War who committed suicide in order to destroy a Kuomintang bunker guarding an approach to an important bridge in Longhua County.
